entry: Seed list provided by the project initialization request.
screening_notes: Metadata and abstracts were inspected. No systematic database or citation search was performed in this initialization.
limitations: Abstract-level review only; no full-text review; no additional seed expansion.

entry: Full-text review of the two direct UAV candidates identified in the seed set.
source: arXiv HTML full-text and abstract pages
screening_notes: 2609.19961 is a position/architecture article with an illustrative LAESim use case and no standalone quantitative benchmark, HIL, or real-flight validation found. 2607.02277 is an actual landing-assessment method with simulation and hardware-in-the-loop evidence and no real-flight validation found; its venue/DOI metadata remains in conflict.
limitations: Only two direct UAV candidates are currently under review; the bounded target of roughly 6-12 candidates has not been reached. Reference tracking from seed papers was not systematically expanded in this iteration.

query_or_resource: Seed records in data/papers.json; no new database search executed
screening_notes: The seven-record seed set contains two direct UAV candidates: p-2609.19961 (position/architecture) and p-2607.02277 (method). The withdrawn record p-2510.22204 is provenance for p-2607.02277 and is not a separate candidate.
limitations: Do not treat this as an exhaustive 6-12 candidate search. Future iterations should prefer reference tracking from the full texts rather than abstract-only queries.

entry: Foundational neuro-symbolic papers, books, and community resources suggested for the auxiliary reference list.
query_or_resource: arXiv exact-title and ID lookups; Crossref bibliographic and DOI metadata lookups; SAIRLab ICRA 2025 workshop page
screening_notes: Added three foundational papers/monographs, four books/edited collections, and one robotics workshop as auxiliary resources. They are catalogued separately from UAV paper records and are not counted as core methods.
limitations: Book chapter contents and workshop papers were not individually screened. The workshop page was verified, but its OpenReview archive contents were not enumerated in this iteration.
